public_rationale: The accessible reporting identifies a February 2023 estimate of $694,444 per day for operating ChatGPT. That contradicts the claimed millions per day on the estimate basis implied by Zitron's linked reporting. It does not contradict the qualitative description of substantial expense. This assessment concerns the historical estimate, not a verified OpenAI bill or later ChatGPT costs.
limitations: The decisive evidence is reputable secondary reporting because the primary analysis was marked PARTIAL.
A modeled estimate cannot establish the exact actual expenditure.
The linked Forbes assertion could not be examined beyond discovering its provenance.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Generative AI products are extremely expensive to run; ChatGPT burns millions of dollars a day in compute.

statement.excerpt: On top of that, these products are extremely expensive to run. ChatGPT burns millions of dollars a day in computing power, while charging a per-access-token price for companies to plug into its models.

from_speaker: ChatGPT burns millions of dollars a day in computing power
our_interpretation: The numerical claim concerns OpenAI's daily computing cost for operating ChatGPT, excluding model training, other products and total company expenses.
I read 'millions of dollars a day' as at least US$2 million daily. The result would be unchanged using a US$1 million threshold.
The ongoing observation describes February 2023 as of the February 16 post. I use that current month, rather than a later operating period.
The post links the cost assertion to Forbes reporting, so the accounting basis is estimate.
'Extremely expensive' supplies no separate measurable threshold. I assess the accompanying daily-cost figure.
criteria.support_condition: A substantiated estimate or disclosure for ChatGPT's contemporaneous daily operating compute cost reaches at least US$2 million.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A credible estimate measuring the same contemporaneous daily operating compute cost places it below US$2 million.
